clusters.description: Slot engine does not license the CVV+V pattern. In Arabic, verb forms using واو الجماعة (masculine plural suffix) end in -ُوا which yields the pattern CVV+V (e.g. نُوا = V:u + V:w + V:a). All such forms are unconditionally BLOCKED. This prevents processing of any masculine plural verb form.
clusters.recommended_action: Add CVV+V to the licensed slot pattern set for Arabic وا-suffix verb forms. The ا in واو الجماعة is orthographic, not a long vowel extension; the CVV pattern يUVA is phonologically valid.

clusters.description: When a proclitic (وَ/فَ) is stripped from a word starting with hamzat al-wasl (همزة الوصل), the remaining token begins with a sukun-bearing consonant. The slot engine flags the initial position as +V (vowel before the first consonant) and issues BLOCK. This prevents processing of any فعل الأمر or مصدر starting with hamzat al-wasl.
clusters.recommended_action: License the +V initial position for tokens whose original form begins with hamzat al-wasl. The segmenter should mark hamzat-al-wasl tokens so the slot engine can apply the correct initial CV licensing rule.

clusters.description: The pre_root module does not strip مضارع verb prefixes (ي/ت/ن/أ) before counting consonants. A trilateral verb like يَكْتُبَ (root ك-ت-ب, 3 radicals) is seen as ي-ك-ت-ب = 4 consonants and deferred with quadriliteral_beyond_scope. Affects all imperfect verb forms. This is the largest single root-extraction defect cluster.
clusters.recommended_action: Implement مضارع prefix detection and stripping in pre_root before consonant counting. Prefixes ي/ت/ن/أ in يَفْعُل/تَفْعُل/نَفْعُل/أَفْعُل patterns must be identified and removed before the radical count is assessed.

clusters.description: When a verb has a geminate (shadda) consonant, the shadda is counted as two separate consonants. Root م-ل-ل in يُمِلَّ/فَلْيُمْلِلْ is treated as م-ل-ل-ل = 4 consonants → quadriliteral_beyond_scope. Same issue affects تَضِلَّ (root ض-ل-ل) and similar geminate patterns.
clusters.recommended_action: Deduplicate geminate radicals: a consonant marked with shadda occupies one radical slot, not two. Update consonant counter to treat شدة-marked consonants as single positions.

clusters.description: For ISM patterns فَعِيل (شَهِيد، ضَعِيف، صَغِير، كَبِير، عَلِيم، شَهِيد، وَلِيّ) and فُعُول/فُعَال/فِعَالَة, the pattern extension vowel/semi-vowel (ي in فَعِيل, ا in فِعَال) is counted as a root consonant, making a trilateral root appear quadriliteral. This affects all nominal فَعِيل/فُعَيل/فُعَال pattern forms.
clusters.recommended_action: Implement pattern-aware consonant extraction: strip known pattern extension elements (ي in فَعِيل, وَ in فُعُول, tanwin ن, dual ين/ان suffixes) before counting root consonants.

clusters.description: After proclitic stripping, function words (لَا، إِنْ، إِنَّ، لَيْسَ، كَمَا، مَنْ) that appear as hosts are not in the word-class lookup catalog. The word_class engine returns DEFERRED (NO_MORPHOLOGY_PATH) for these well-known particles and operators.
clusters.recommended_action: Add لَا، إِنْ، إِنَّ، لَيْسَ، كَمَا، مَنْ as HARF entries in the post-proclitic host word-class catalog. These are high-frequency function words that must be recognized when appearing as the host after proclitic stripping.

clusters.description: الَّذِينَ and الَّذِي are catalog-protected in the segmenter (CATALOG_PROTECTED) but the mabni verdict returns OPEN, so the word_class engine cannot assign HARF/CLOSED_FUNCTION_WORD. The catalog protection covers segmentation only, not word-class assignment.
clusters.recommended_action: Add الَّذِينَ and الَّذِي to the mabni operator catalog with blocks_root_path=True and word_class=HARF. The segmenter catalog and the mabni catalog must share the same entries for catalog-protected tokens.

clusters.description: Several verb forms are assigned ISM word class (MASDAR or LEXICAL_NOUN) by the word_class_engine. This occurs when the morphological pattern analysis routes the form through the nominal path instead of the verbal path. Root extraction may be correct but the word class is wrong.
affected_tokens: عَلَّمَهُ[021] (ISM/MASDAR; should be FI3L Form II فعل ماضٍ)
يَسْتَطِيعُ[045] (ISM/MASDAR; should be FI3L Form X imperfect)
فَتُذَكِّرَ[069] (ISM/MASDAR; should be FI3L Form II imperfect)
تُدِيرُونَهَا[101] (ISM/LEXICAL_NOUN; should be FI3L Form IV imperfect)
clusters.recommended_action: Audit the word_class routing decision for verb patterns: فَعَّلَ (Form II), يَسْتَفْعِل (Form X), تُفَعِّل (Form II imperfect), تُفْعِل (Form IV), and imperfect forms with lam al-amr proclitics must all route to FI3L, not ISM.

clusters.description: Several nominal and adverbial forms are assigned FI3L/VERBAL_PAST word class. This occurs when the morphological pattern for an ISM happens to match a verbal pattern (e.g. geminate noun الحق matches فَعَّلَ Form II, بَيْن matches بَيَّنَ, عِنْد matches verb pattern).
affected_tokens: الْحَقُّ[027] (FI3L; should be ISM — definite article blocks verbal reading)
بَيْنَكُمْ[012] (FI3L; should be ISM/HARF — بَيْن is a preposition)
الْأُخْرَى[071] (FI3L; should be ISM — feminine comparative adjective)
عِنْدَ[089] (FI3L; should be ISM/ظرف — adverb of place)
رَبَّهُ[030] (FI3L; should be ISM — his Lord, accusative noun)
clusters.recommended_action: Add disambiguation rules: (1) tokens with definite article ال must route to ISM first; (2) known ظروف (بَيْن، عِنْد، أَمَام، etc.) must be cataloged as ISM/HARF; (3) alef maqsura adjectives (أُخْرَى، كُبْرَى) must route to ISM.

clusters.description: لفظ الجلالة (اللَّه) is not uniformly catalog-protected. Results are inconsistent across case forms: اللَّهُ/اللَّهِ receive ISM/MASDAR with root=[ء,ل,ل] (wrong word_class, theologically contested root); اللَّهَ receives DEFERRED; وَاللَّهُ receives root=[و,ل,ل] — catastrophically including the وَ proclitic as a root consonant. This is the most severe provenance defect in the corpus.
affected_tokens: وَاللَّهُ[125] (ISM/MASDAR; root=[و,ل,ل] — CRITICAL: proclitic in root)
clusters.recommended_action: Add all inflected forms of اللَّه (اللَّهُ/اللَّهَ/اللَّهِ) to the mabni catalog as PROPER_NOUN with blocks_root_path=True and allows_root_path=False. The proclitic boundary must be enforced before root extraction so that وَ+اللَّه does not contaminate the root with the و radical.

clusters.description: The pre_root module does not open the root path for medial-waw (أجوف) verbs like تَكُون/يَكُون, or for tokens with defective endings like الشُّهَدَاء/الشَّهَادَة. These produce overall verdict=DEFER or WORD_CLASS_DEFERRED with root_path_not_opened_by_pre_root.
clusters.recommended_action: Extend pre_root to handle: (1) medial-waw verb paradigms (أجوف: كون/قول/بيع); (2) جمع التكسير plural patterns (فُعَلَاء); (3) مصدر patterns (فَعَالَة). These are high-frequency structures that must open the root path.
